about: The workspace's event catalog: every log line is one of these events, its id and values only; the sentence is the template here. Addresses are the original game file's, in hex; values print in hex, floats in decimal, a value of no printable type as ?.

fields.a: its arguments, in order (absent when it takes none)

fields.c: the callee, by address or import name

fields.a: its arguments, in order (absent when it takes none); the file calls' seam logs their numbers alone, never a pointer
fields.h: the heap the block came from or goes to: the C library's memory helpers alone
fields.v: the value it returned (absent when void)
fields.p: the file name the call was given, as text: the file calls' seam alone
fields.to: the new name a move was given, as text
fields.n: the bytes a read or write moved, read from its out-pointer after the call
fields.found: the file name a find call found, empty when it found none
fields.e: the last error the file calls' seam left for the shell to read: 0 on success

events.template: the layer's call to {c} with {a} returned {v}
